2026-08-04 11:20:55.976010 | controller | The unit files have no installation config (WantedBy=, RequiredBy=, UpheldBy=,
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979935 | controller | Also=, or Alias= settings in the [Install] section, and DefaultInstance= for
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979960 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979965 | controller |
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979969 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979973 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979979 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979985 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979990 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-04 11:20:55.979996 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-04 11:20:55.980001 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
